method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Equities: Geopolitics and yields pressure stocks - Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank’s Jim Reid notes that global equities ended August on a softer footing as escalating US-Iran tensions and a hawkish Jackson Hole speech from Fed Chair Warsh weighed on risk sentiment.
Equities.reason: Broad, market-wide narrative: geopolitics (US–Iran tensions) plus hawkish Fed commentary = risk‑off impulse and potential higher yields that pressure equities. High relevance because it captures macro regime and cross-market drivers.

Equities.title: Tehran urges return to June deal, oil prices rise as Trump vows to hit Iran 'hard'
Equities.summary: Iran launched an attack on two American bases in Jordan on Monday in retaliation for the U.S. attack on its Larak Island.
Equities.reason: Direct geopolitical shock raising oil/energy risk premium and denting risk appetite; reinforces broader risk‑off/yields narrative that pressures equities, especially cyclicals and growth.

Equities.title: Stock market today: Dow, S&P 500, Nasdaq futures fall as inflation, Fed rate-hike fears persist
Equities.reason: Market-level headline linking inflation and Fed rate‑hike fears to weaker futures — feeds the dominant macro narrative of rising rates / sticky inflation undermining equities.

Equities.title: Risk-reward outlook for stocks is getting worse as historically tough month kicks off, says Citadel Securities
Equities.summary: The risk-reward of buying protection in the equity market looks compelling.
Equities.reason: Institutional flow/positioning signal: rising demand for protection and a worsening risk‑reward backdrop supports a cautious/defensive equities stance.

Equities.title: Qualcomm rival MediaTek jumps 10% after $3.5 billion Nvidia AI chip deal
Equities.summary: The two companies will work on integrating Nvidia technology with MediaTek's custom AI chip business as well as other areas such as PCs and cars.
Equities.reason: Positive sector-level signal for AI/semis leadership: large AI chip partnership supports earnings and investment themes in tech, offsetting some macro weakness in risk appetite.

Equities.title: Anthropic agrees to $35bn cloud contract with Lambda
Equities.reason: Large AI/cloud spending deal that supports tech revenue growth and the AI investment narrative — positive for software/cloud/AI-exposed equities.

Equities.title: FTC sues Amazon, accusing the e-commerce giant of misleading advertisers
Equities.summary: The FTC sued Amazon, alleging the company misled advertisers through a deceptive auctioning system.
Equities.reason: Regulatory/legal headwind for mega-cap tech and ad-revenue models — a negative idiosyncratic but with broader implications for valuations in the sector.

Equities.title: Fast-fashion giant Shein's shares drop 9% in Hong Kong market debut
Equities.summary: Shein made its Hong Kong market debut on Tuesday after years of attempts to go public.
Equities.reason: Weak IPO debut highlights investor caution toward large consumer/China listings and may weigh on broader primary-market sentiment; relevant but more idiosyncratic than macro headlines.

Rates.title: Global bond sell-off deepens amid inflation fears
Rates.summary: UK borrowing costs rise to highest since 2008 while Japan yields hit levels not seen since 1990s
Rates.reason: Broad global selloff in government bonds, rising yields across major markets; large macro implication for central-bank policy and funding costs (strongly negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: Bond selloff deepens as rising energy prices stoke inflation fears
Rates.reason: Energy-driven inflation upside is being priced into rates, amplifying the bond selloff and pushing yields higher (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Global Bond Selloff Sends Yields to the Highest Level Since 2008
Rates.reason: Syndicated coverage that yields are at multiyear highs across regions — reinforces global higher-for-longer narrative and risk of further repricing.

Rates.title: Japan’s 10-Year Bond Yield Hits 3% for First Time Since 1996
Rates.reason: Major policy and market-test event: Japan yields breaching long-standing thresholds raises risk of central-bank response/intervention and stresses global bond markets (negative for bond holders).

Rates.title: Global bond rout deepens as Japan yield hits key threshold
Rates.reason: Additional confirmation that Japan’s yield move is amplifying the rout; meaningful but somewhat redundant to other global coverage so slightly lower relevance.

Rates.title: Japanese borrowing costs hit 30-year high as Bessent says Tokyo may intervene to boost yen
Rates.summary: The yen weakened to 160 per dollar on Tuesday as bond yields came under pressure, as traders eyed the potential for Japan to hike interest rates.
Rates.reason: Country-specific stress: sharp rise in Japanese borrowing costs raises intervention/hiking risk and spillovers to global rates and FX (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: US 30-Year Bond Enters September on Its Worst Stretch Since 2006
Rates.reason: Significant deterioration in U.S. long-end performance — highlights sustained selling pressure and duration losses for investors (negative for bond portfolios).

Rates.title: The 10-year Treasury yield just crossed a key threshold that should make people ‘sit up and take notice’
Rates.reason: Investor-focused note calling attention to a psychological/technical threshold in the 10y — adds to market attention but lower relevance than macro flow pieces.

Rates.title: Markets see Warsh endorsing a rate hike in September. Not everyone is convinced
Rates.reason: Fed policy repricing after public signals (Warsh/Jackson Hole) is lifting odds of near-term hikes — negative for bond prices as markets price higher terminal rates.

Rates.title: September Fed rate hike fears look overblown as the probability stands at just 58%, not 90%
Rates.reason: Counterpoint on Fed-hike odds that, if correct, would relieve some near-term rate pressure — small positive for bonds but lower relevance relative to dominant selloff narrative.

Rates.title: Mortgage rates surge to the highest since June 2025 as new Middle East attacks push oil prices up
Rates.summary: The expectation had been for falling rates this year, but the war with Iran and its resulting rise in oil prices upended that.
Rates.reason: Higher market yields are transmitting to consumer borrowing costs; geopolitically-driven oil shock reinforces inflation/higher-rates narrative (negative for fixed-income).

FX.title: Eurozone flash HICP rises 3.3% YoY in August, as expected
FX.summary: Eurozone’s preliminary Harmonized Index of Consumer Prices (HICP) data for August arrives at 3.3% Year-on-Year (YoY), as expected, higher than the previous reading of 2.9%. On a monthly basis, inflationary pressures grew at a faster pace of 0.4% against the pr
FX.reason: Stronger-than-previous Eurozone HICP (3.3% YoY) increases odds of ECB tightening; supportive for EUR vs USD and other currencies — important macro inflation shock directly driving FX.

FX.title: Eurozone inflation rises to 3.3% in August
FX.summary: ECB expected to lift interest rates next week as higher energy prices bite
FX.reason: Confirmation from a major outlet that inflation is rising and the ECB is likely to hike lifts the market-wide EUR tightening narrative — a broad, market-moving FX driver that reinforces EUR strength.

FX.title: Euro: Proactive ECB seen as supportive – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Michael Pfister at Commerzbank notes that several central banks, including the European Central Bank (ECB), have already raised rates following the inflation shock linked to the Iran conflict.
FX.reason: Analyst view that a proactive ECB (following inflation shock) supports the euro; reinforces the ECB-tightening / EUR-positive narrative but is commentary rather than fresh data.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: DXY eyes 99.75 confluence hurdle amid Fed bets, Iran risks
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, regains positive traction on Tuesday and climbs back above the mid-99.00s during the first half of the European session.
FX.reason: DXY regaining traction (mid-99s) on Fed bets and geopolitical risk supports broad USD strength — negative for non-USD currencies and a primary FX driver right now.

FX.title: Japanese Yen: BoJ hike expectations shape FX – MUFG
FX.summary: Michael Wan at MUFG notes continued dispersion in Asia FX, with USD/JPY trading just below 160. NHK reports US officials urging Japan to raise interest rates, while markets already price a 92% chance of a September Bank of Japan (BoJ) hike.
FX.reason: High market pricing of a BoJ hike (92%) and external pressure on Japan to raise rates point to potential JPY strength / USD/JPY downside — a central-bank driven FX narrative in Asia.

FX.title: US Dollar: Fed restraint supports gains against peers – OCBC
FX.summary: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong have reset their forecasts after the earlier US Dollar (USD) sell-off but still projects moderate USD strength into early 2027.
FX.reason: Bank strategist view that Fed 'restraint' (relative policy stance) underpins USD strength versus peers — supports a medium-term USD-positive bias that affects major currency pairs.

FX.title: Indian Rupee gains on India's upbeat Q2 GDP, narrowed fiscal deficit data
FX.summary: The Indian Rupee (INR) gains sharply against the US Dollar on Tuesday. The USD/INR pair slumps to near 94.80, the lowest level seen in two months, on likely Reserve Bank of India (RBI) intervention, stronger-than-expected Q2 Gross Domestic Product (GDP) data a
FX.reason: Firm Q2 GDP and likely RBI intervention pushing USD/INR lower is a clear EM FX move — reflects currency-specific central-bank intervention and fundamentals driving INR strength vs USD.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar: RBNZ hike seen with dovish risks – ING
FX.summary: ING’s Francesco Pesole expects the Reserve Bank of New Zealand to raise rates by 25bp to 2.75%, with markets fully pricing the move. He argues that current market pricing for further tightening looks too hawkish unless the RBNZ lifts its rate path significantl
FX.reason: RBNZ hike fully priced supports NZD upside, but ING flags dovish risks which cap the move — a central-bank-led NZD narrative with limited immediate upside.

Commodities.title: Two Oil Supertankers Hit by Projectiles in Hormuz, Marisks Says
Commodities.reason: Direct supply disruption/shipping risk in the Strait of Hormuz raises oil risk premium and immediate upside for crude prices — high-impact geopolitical shock for commodities.

Commodities.title: Oil Extends Advance as US-Iran Escalation Revives Hormuz Risks
Commodities.reason: Market narrative: renewed US-Iran escalation revives Middle East supply disruption fears, supporting higher oil prices and adding to the prevailing upside momentum.

Commodities.title: Brent: Uptrend eyes 102 and 110 – Societe Generale
Commodities.summary: Societe Generale strategists note Brent has held above key moving averages near $85/84, keeping upward momentum intact as geopolitical tensions and higher energy prices drive a broader bond rout.
Commodities.reason: Technical/strategist note pointing to continued Brent upside; price-forecast/technical content → modest relevance under commodities scoring rules.

Commodities.title: Brent Oil: Geopolitics delay supply recovery – OCBC
Commodities.summary: OCBC strategists Sim Moh Siong and Christopher Wong raise their end-2026 Brent forecast to USD 80/bbl from USD 75/bbl as Middle East supply disruptions prove more prolonged. They note falling inventories, rising transport costs and emerging diesel shortages as
Commodities.reason: Fundamental analyst forecast raising end-2026 Brent on prolonged Middle East supply disruptions, falling inventories and transport constraints — reinforces bullish oil supply narrative.

Commodities.title: Trump warns 'we're going to hit them hard' after Iran targets U.S. forces in Jordan: Report
Commodities.summary: The latest attacks prompted oil prices to climb above $90 a barrel, as energy market participants monitored the prospect of renewed supply risks.
Commodities.reason: Escalatory political/military rhetoric following strikes that already pushed oil above $90 — short-to-medium-term bullish for oil via heightened supply-risk premium.

Commodities.title: Venezuela grants U.S.-backed oil firm NABEP 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says
Commodities.summary: Venezuelan interim authorities have granted North American Blue Energy Partners 100-year concessions for 17 oil fields, White House says.
Commodities.reason: Policy/contract awards likely to increase longer-term Venezuelan oil development and potential supply into markets — modestly bearish for oil fundamentals over time.

Commodities.title: Eight petroleum liquids pipeline projects have been completed since the start of 2025
Commodities.summary: In the 2026 release of our Liquids Pipeline Projects Database, we tracked the completion of 8 liquid fuels pipeline projects since the start of 2025, and an additional 14 new projects have been announced.
Commodities.reason: Infrastructure completions increase logistics capacity for petroleum liquids, easing regional supply bottlenecks over time — modest negative for tightness.

Commodities.title: Dangote refinery drives increase in petroleum shipments from Nigeria
Commodities.summary: Seaborne petroleum product exports from Nigeria have grown seven-fold since 2023, playing an increasing role in the international market for petroleum products at a time when supplies from other areas have been constrained.
Commodities.reason: New refinery-driven exports from Nigeria increase product supply to global markets, relieving some regional shortages — modestly bearish for crude/product prices.

Commodities.title: Gold drops to nearly two-week low, below $4,400 on hawkish Fed bets and firm USD
Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) weakens further below the $4,400 mark, hitting a nearly two-week low during the first half of the European session on Tuesday. Traders ramped up bets for a rate hike in September following Federal Reserve (Fed) Chair Kevin Warsh's remarks last F
Commodities.reason: Hawkish Fed expectations and a stronger USD weigh on non-yielding gold — clear negative for bullion in the current macro regime.

Commodities.title: Gold muted as traders await US jobs data, monitor Mideast tensions
Commodities.reason: Near-term gold positioning is cautious ahead of US jobs data; mixed forces (risk premium from Mideast vs. hawkish rates/USD) create slight negative tilt.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecasts: XAG/USD looks for direction above key support at $65.50 area
Commodities.summary: Silver (XAG/USD) remains practically flat on Tuesday, holding most of Friday’s losses and trading at $66.60 at the time of writing, with price action contained within the previous day’s range.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-forecast focus and rate-hike expectations weigh on silver alongside gold; scoring capped for technical content.

Commodities.title: Soybean Futures Hit Highest Since 2023 on US Biofuel Exemptions
Commodities.reason: US biofuel exemptions boost demand for soybean-related products, pushing futures to multiyear highs — positive demand-driven commodity impulse for soybeans.

Crypto.title: Live updates: Bitcoin ETFs resume buying as ether funds stretch streak to 11 days
Crypto.reason: ETF buy flows are a primary institutional demand channel for crypto (BTC/ETH). Resumption of ETF purchases and multi-day ether fund inflows signal meaningful buy-side demand and liquidity into the market — a broad positive for prices and sentiment. High relevance because ETF flows are market-moving.

Crypto.title: Strategy returns to bitcoin buys, adding $370 million of BTC last week
Crypto.reason: Large, concentrated institutional purchases materially raise demand for bitcoin and reinforce the ETF/inflow-driven bull narrative. Significant dollar-denominated buys are a clear positive for BTC price mechanics and market structure.

Crypto.title: Bitmine makes largest ether purchase since June as Tom Lee points to crypto's strong Q3
Crypto.reason: Notable institutional accumulation of ether supports demand-side momentum for ETH. The move reinforces ongoing buying themes for major tokens and adds to positive flow-based narratives for the quarter.

Crypto.title: CME’s share of XRP futures jumps as token rallies 40% in a week
Crypto.reason: Shift of futures activity toward a regulated venue (CME) signals growing institutional participation and market maturation for a major token. That institutionalization is a positive structural development for liquidity and price discovery.

Crypto.title: Cronos halts blockchain after $75 million lending exploit hits lending app Tectonic
Crypto.reason: A large exploit and chain halt materially undermines protocol-level trust, can trigger outflows, insurance/credit losses and regulatory scrutiny. This is a high-relevance negative for on-chain risk appetite and short-term token prices in the affected ecosystem and broader market sentiment.

Crypto.title: North Korean hackers are moving tens of millions on Hyperliquid as Trump pushes to onshore the crypto platform
Crypto.reason: Evidence of state-backed illicit flows increases AML/OSINT concerns and can accelerate regulatory and onshoring policy responses. Illicit activity linked to exchanges/platforms is a negative for industry credibility and could constrain flows or invite stricter controls.

Crypto.title: Ireland bars crypto from new tax-advantaged investment accounts
Crypto.reason: A regulatory exclusion from tax-advantaged vehicles is a direct headwind to retail/institutional adoption and tax-efficient flows in that market. Represents a localized but meaningful negative for market access and demand.

Crypto.title: NYSE owner ICE taps tZERO for tokenized securities push, takes stake in firm
Crypto.reason: Major exchange operator investing in tokenization infrastructure signals institutional adoption of blockchain-based securities. This is a structural positive for broader crypto integration with traditional finance, though impact is more medium-term.

Crypto.title: Sberbank plans to add ether and USDT as collateral for crypto-backed loans: Report
Crypto.reason: A large bank adding crypto assets as collateral expands demand channels and mainstream use-cases for tokens. Regional/geopolitical nuances limit universality, so relevance is moderate but net positive for on-chain collateralization and lending markets.

Crypto.title: Michael Saylor hints at first bitcoin purchase in two months
Crypto.reason: High-profile buyers can influence sentiment and signal conviction; a potential purchase by a well-known institutional holder is a modest positive for demand and market psychology, but it's idiosyncratic and lower relevance than broad flow data.
